A gift for the journey ahead

BC Ferries Gift Certificates, available in $10, $25, $50 and $100 denominations and can be used toward ferry bookings, meals on board or shopping at Passages.

Buy now 

More bookable space, kids sail free between Powell River and Comox

We've increased bookable space and added Saver fares on select sailings to make travel more predictable. Drive-up space remains available but will be limited.

Learn more 

Horseshoe Bay travel changes

Customers travelling by vehicle from Horseshoe Bay to Departure Bay (Nanaimo) need to book and pay in advance due to critical upgrades.

View Horseshoe Bay travel info 

Sail for less between the Sunshine Coast and Vancouver

More bookable space, Saver fares from $39 return between Langdale and Horseshoe Bay.

Learn more 

Fresh Flavours. Familiar Favourites.

We’re serving a new menu at Seascapes - while keeping your favourites right where they belong. Escape the crowds, savour locally inspired dishes, and take in the stunning onboard views.

Ferry news & updates


Two new vessels with names gifted by Snuneymuxw First Nation in service

Island xwsaĺux̌ul and Island sarlequun are now in service between Nanaimo and Gabriola Island, carrying names gifted by the Snuneymuxw First Nation.

Learn more 

Annual Report

Read about our progress and achievements from last year, as well as key areas of strategic focus for the year ahead.

Read the report 

BC Ferries welcomes Island sarlequun to its fleet

BC Ferries welcomed its newest Island Class vessel, Island sarlequun, to its fleet in a naming ceremony recognizing the name gifted by Snuneymuxw First Nation.

Learn more 

Klahoose First Nation raises welcome pole at Whaletown terminal

Klahoose First Nation held a traditional ceremony at the BC Ferries Whaletown terminal that included the raising of a welcome pole. The event coincided with the arrival of Island Nagalis on this route.

Learn more 

Celebrating Team Canada

We've teamed up with Canada Soccer, CSME and White Spot to bring fans together to celebrate Canada's historic FIFA World Cup 2026™ campaign and support youth soccer in BC.

Learn more 

BC Ferries welcomes the return of the restored Persephone to Town of Gibsons

The restored Persephone, iconic tugboat from The Beachcombers, preserves Gibsons’ coastal heritage, waterfront history, and Sunshine Coast stories for future generations.

Learn more 

BC Ferries celebrates the arrival of Island xwsaĺux̌ul to strengthen inter-island ferry service

Island xwsaĺux̌ul is the first of four new Island Class vessels arriving as part of our ongoing fleet renewal program. The vessel name was gifted by Snuneymuxw First Nation.

Learn more 

Introducing the Summit Class

Summit Arbutus, Summit Cedar, Summit Maple, and Summit Spruce. 

New major vessels coming to the coast in 2029.

Learn more 

Preparing for a busy summer as demand grows and system pressures are expected to continue

We're preparing for another busy summer season, with demand expected to exceed last year’s record levels with major events like the FIFA World Cup 2026™.

Learn more
